name: Moz Pro
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Moz Pro, track selected keywords and audit one owned site without recreating Moz's link index. The hard boundary is proprietary link index, keyword data, scoring, education, and campaign history, plus proprietary web index and data acquisition.
